shortDescription: Software consultant deployed on long-term engagements at client companies (Silverfin, Volvo Cars Belgium)
details:
Employed as a software consultant at Axxes, deployed on long-term engagements at client companies. The Axxes traineeship onboarded me to a modern full-stack toolset before placement; subsequent assignments at Silverfin and Volvo Cars Belgium are documented under their own entries.

Axxes provides continuous learning support and a community of consultants — I attend internal knowledge sessions and contribute to the broader engineering culture between and alongside client work.
